ACTION: Read ~/.claude/skills/writing-skills/references/claude-code.md for Claude Code's exact listing rule: how the budget works, which skills lose their descriptions first, and what survives compaction.

My working theory, not yet confirmed: the skill listing has overflowed. discovery.md says a runtime may drop or shorten descriptions when its listing overflows, and that is the warning `/doctor` is giving you. Roughly 150 skills, most from three plugins, would explain it. Nothing in `api-naming` changed. Its 410-character description is fine on its own. It likely lost its description, or was cut back to name only, when the plugins pushed the total over budget. That fits the symptoms:

- **Typing `/api-naming` still works.** Explicit invocation loads the skill by name and doesn't depend on the description.
- **Auto-triggering stopped.** Auto-triggering needs the description, because that is the only text the model sees before the skill loads.

I'm reading claude-code.md now to confirm which skills get cut and by what rule. I'll then check the plugin skill descriptions against that budget. Once I know the rule, the fix will probably be some mix of these:

1. Disable or uninstall plugin skills you don't use. This is the biggest lever, since the plugins account for most of the 150.
2. Tighten the longest plugin and local descriptions to triggers only.
3. Use `disable-model-invocation` on skills that should only run when you type them, so they stop competing for listing space.

I'd rather not edit the `api-naming` description yet. Its text isn't the problem, and under the skill-writing rules any description change needs a baseline test first. I'll come back with the confirmed cause and a specific list of changes for you to approve.
